title: 5 Mistakes Tourists Make in China — And None Are Cultural | China Travel Expert
description:
Five mistakes tourists make in China — and not one of them is cultural.

The things that actually trip people up are practical. Your foreign card won't work in most shops, taxis or noodle spots, so you'll want Alipay or WeChat Pay (both now let you link an overseas card). Google, WhatsApp, Instagram and Gmail are blocked, so sort out roaming or a travel eSIM before you land. Big cities like Beijing and Shanghai have four or five separate railway stations — double-check which one your train leaves from. More and more top sights need a booking days ahead. And flying everywhere means skipping the country the bullet train rolls you straight through.

🧭 Expert Tip: Set up Alipay or WeChat Pay before you fly — link your card at home while your bank's verification texts still reach you.

在中国，游客最容易栽的五个坑，几乎全是'实用'问题，不是文化问题。
